title: Minimum Window Containing All Required Characters
statement: Given two strings s and t, return the shortest contiguous substring of s that contains every character of t, honoring multiplicity: if a character appears k times in t, the window must contain it at least k times. If several windows tie on length, return the leftmost one (the one with the smallest starting index). If no window of s satisfies the requirement, return the empty string "". Comparisons are case-sensitive, and t may contain repeated characters.
hints: You need the shortest contiguous window covering a requirement. What lets you grow a window on the right and trim it on the left without rescanning?
Track a count for each required character (a Counter of t), plus how many required slots are still unmet. A character only reduces the deficit while your window still has fewer of it than t demands.

Expand right and increment the window's count of that char, decrementing the deficit only if the count is still at or below what t needs. Whenever the deficit hits zero, record the window if it beats the best, then shrink from the left in a while loop, raising the deficit back the moment removing a char drops it below t's requirement. Keep the leftmost of any length-tied windows by only replacing best on a strictly smaller length.
